text: This solution, Scaling Climate and Disaster Risk Financing Framework and Parametric Insurance in Fiji addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Fiji between Government of Fiji, Reserve Bank of Fiji, United Nations Capital Development Fund (UNCDF), India–UN Development Partnership Fund, UN Office for South–South Cooperation (UNOSSC), United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), Asian Development Bank (ADB), FijiCare Insurance Limited, Sun Insurance, Tower Insurance, Digicel, and Vodafone. The program was implemented in 2020 and focuses on collaboration, accessibility, and leveraging tech.
